summary: Josephine County twin summits: 1935 pole tower on the north summit, 1962 R-6 timber tower on the south; listed as ruins, removed, and gone.

facts.design: 41-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat-roof cab (1962)
facts.status_note: One listing calls the site ruins, another marks the tower removed, and the county directory lists the tower as gone.

events.note: 40-foot pole tower of the L-4 type on the north summit.
41-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat-roof cab on the south summit; replaced an older tower about one mile north.

evidence.supports: About 17 miles west-southwest of Grants Pass
Siskiyou National Forest is the land manager
1935 40-foot pole L-4 tower on the north summit
evidence.quote: 1935: 40' pole L-4 tower on north summit.

evidence.supports: 1962 41-foot treated timber R-6 tower on the south summit; site described as ruins
evidence.quote: 1962: 41' treated timber R-6 tower on south summit. Ruins.

evidence.supports: 1962 41-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat-roof cab replaced an older tower about one mile north
evidence.quote: 1962: A 41-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 flat-roof cab constructed. This tower replaced an older tower located approximately one mile north.

evidence.supports: County directory lists the Serpentine tower as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Ruins, the Oregon Lookouts page says Removed, and the county directory says Tower Gone. All three agree the tower no longer stands; the record keeps status gone and the note explains the wording.

notes_for_editor: Two independent pages agree on the 1962 tower; only firelookout.com dates the 1935 tower, since the Oregon Lookouts page does not mention it. Both are hobbyist directories with no primary citations, and neither gives a removal date. The Oregon Lookouts index lists a separate Serpentine - 1 at 37S-8W-9, while Serpentine - 2 is 37S-8W-16; the brief's coordinates 42.35097,-123.65936 come from the directory and are not tied to either page, so check which page they belong to. Brief design R-6 and height 12.5 m (41 ft) are supported for the 1962 tower. No staffing, access or current-site source found; one WebSearch added nothing about this lookout. Access left unset.
